issues.title: Table name casing
issues.problem: Table names are in uppercase but should be in lowercase to match the schema.

issues.title: Missing filter for revenue calculation
issues.problem: The query does not filter transactions by status to calculate revenue correctly.
issues.fix: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM fact_transactions WHERE status = 'COMPLETED';

issues.title: Missing filter for failure rate calculation
issues.problem: The query does not filter transactions by status to calculate failure rate correctly.
issues.fix: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate FROM fact_transactions;

issues.title: Lack of comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining its purpose and logic.
issues.fix:
-- Count all transactions
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_transactions;

review.summary: The query has readability issues and lacks correctness in calculating revenue and failure rate. Comments and proper casing should be added.
